headers: can/could 天生的或学到的能力
表示成功地完成某一具体动作时
rows: Can / Could I borrow you pen?表示请求别人允许或答复时的情况
I can have lunch with your tomorrow if you like.可以表示可能性

I could drive a car by the time I was sixteen.过去时 I tried again and found I could / was able to swim .过去时 Can Jane swim yet?现在时 No, but she’ll be able to swim in a few months’ time. 表示将来的“能力”时，则用 will be able to
Look! I can stand on my head.

It’s pity he couldn’t visit Mary. 如果表示某一动作没有取得成功，则可用 couldn’t Oh, didn’t you know? He was able to visit her after all. 通常不用 could，而用 be able to He was able to leave Europe before the war began. 他在战争开始之前得以离开欧洲。 He was able to go to London yesterday and he enjoyed himself very much.
Could he borrow a car? 可用 could Yes, he was able to borrow a car after all./No, he couldn’t. 但回答是肯定的时候则不能

He behaves very strange at times.
